bio: Experienced DoorDash Dasher in SF Downtown. 2 years of delivery experience. Prefers morning shifts. Moderate price sensitivity — will accept $2+ incentives in my home zone but need $3+ to travel to other zones. Daily income goal: $100.

New DoorDash Dasher in Oakland. Just started 2 weeks ago. Very price sensitive — will accept almost any incentive to build experience. Flexible schedule. Willing to work any zone. Daily income goal: $60.
Part-time DoorDash Dasher in San Jose. Works evenings after my day job. Low price sensitivity — only takes high-value incentives ($4+). Sticks to South Bay zones. Daily income goal: $40.

Full-time Dasher in Berkeley. 6 months experience. Moderate elasticity. Prefers East Bay but will cross to SF for good incentives ($3+). Watches what other dashers do — tends to follow the crowd. Daily income goal: $120.

Weekend warrior Dasher in Palo Alto. Only works Saturday and Sunday. Very strategic — compares zone incentives before accepting. High risk tolerance, will travel far for the right price. Daily income goal: $80.

Experienced Dasher in Mountain View. 1 year tenure. Gets fatigued quickly — after 4 offers in a day, starts rejecting everything. Prefers afternoon shifts. Moderate income needs. Daily income goal: $70.

Multi-app Dasher (DoorDash + Uber Eats) in SF Mission. Compares incentives across platforms. Will only accept DoorDash offers if they beat the Uber Eats alternative. High elasticity. Daily income goal: $110.

Loyal DoorDash Dasher in Oakland Hills. 18 months tenure. Low elasticity — accepts most offers in home zone regardless of amount. Rarely switches zones. Stable and predictable. Daily income goal: $90.
Student Dasher in SF Sunset. Works between classes, unpredictable schedule. Very price sensitive and zone-flexible. Will chase the highest incentive across all zones. Daily income goal: $50.
Veteran Dasher in San Jose South. 3 years experience. Knows the optimal zones and times. Low fatigue, high endurance. Moderate elasticity but strategic about zone selection. Daily income goal: $130.
